staged_proof.name: One pediatric article and measurement qualification
funded_outputs: One exact intended article/administration-route specification with salt/base basis and a justified comparator
Content/delivery uniformity, solid form, dissolution, stability, impurities and method-validation acceptance criteria
Parent+AGI-16903 / chiral D-2-HG sampling and assay plan linked to organ function, medicines and tolerability
Prospectively specified exploratory feasibility protocol with claims separated by baseline state
staged_proof.advance_if: Delivered article and measurements can generate interpretable exposure/PD/function observations
redirect_if: Article fails identity, uniformity, recovery, stability or analytical qualification
Proposed presentation duplicates an adequate existing option without a remaining improvement question
staged_proof.not_required: Repeating generic mouse or cell efficacy before clinical article/exposure work

staged_proof.name: Exploratory exposure/PD and organ-function feasibility
funded_outputs: Linked longitudinal exposure, administration, chiral D-2-HG, tolerability and concomitant-medication dataset
One claim-specific primary organ question with baseline severity retained
Appropriate repeated-baseline/natural-history comparison and masked outcome reading where feasible
Growth-aware cardiac assessment: age/body-size normalization of dimensions and mass, with contemporaneous height/weight and heart-failure medication changes.
staged_proof.advance_if: Reliable delivery and measurements characterize observed exposure, sustained biochemical control, tolerability within the studied follow-up, and interpretable function or preservation; exploratory experience does not define validated infant safety bounds.
redirect_if: Exposure-associated harm or interaction concerns undermine article
Baseline ceiling or measurement variability prevents intended functional interpretation
limits: No deliberate withdrawal solely to manufacture evidence
Exploratory association is not a confirmed controlled efficacy estimate
A small selected cohort cannot define validated infant safety bounds.

staged_proof.name: Confirm benefit and independent product contribution
funded_outputs: Predeclared useful-effect threshold, independent review and defensible comparator
Genotype/severity-aware estimate with uncertainty and sensitivities for concurrent therapy, maturation and missingness
Evidence that proposed delivery/exposure adjustment improves burden/tolerability while retaining benefit
Practicable manufacturing/development and value-capture route for a larger program
staged_proof.advance_if: Benefit-exposure relation and specific product advantage survive confirmatory analysis
redirect_if: Narrow indication when only a particular organ/genotype/baseline state benefits
Change article when target remains plausible but delivery/exposure is unsuitable
staged_proof.stop_if: No useful advantage over existing treatment is demonstrated; scientific dataset may still have value

Independent biological replication with donor/clone/differentiation structure retained

No currently cataloged exact-disease cardiac pair verified
